defs.def: to start an activity, especially an organized one 开始从事，发起，发动（尤指有组织的活动）
to make a product available to the public for the first time （首次）上市，发行
to put a ship or boat into the water, especially one that has just been built 使（船，尤指新船）下水
to send sth such as a spacecraft, weapon, etc. into space, into the sky or through water 发射；把（航天器、武器等）发射上天；水中发射

ex.s: SPACE SHUTTLE CHALLENGER DISASTER Time: 1 _________________ Place: Space Centre in Florida, USA Crew: 2 _________________, including a teacher What was special about the Challenger launch?
ex.t: 挑战者号航天飞机灾难。时间：……地点：美国佛罗里达州太空中心。机组人员：……包括一名教师。挑战者号发射有什么特别之处？

defs.def: to jump forwards with a lot of force 猛扑向前
to start a computer program 启动（计算机程序）

ex.s: Why does Barcelona launch the MetroCharge project?
ex.t: 巴塞罗那为什么启动MetroCharge项目？

ex.s: Riders have printed nearly 20,000 short stories and poems since the program was launched last March.
ex.t: 自去年3月该项目启动以来，乘客已打印了近两万篇短篇故事和诗歌。

ex.s: Silent Spring was therefore regarded as a milestone in the launch of the green movement in the Western world.
ex.t: 《寂静的春天》因此被视为西方世界绿色运动启动的里程碑。

defs.def: the action of launching sth; an event at which sth is launched （航天器的）发射；（船的）下水；（产品的）上市；（事件的）发起

ex.s: Which shuttle followed the Challenger, and when was it launched?
ex.t: 挑战者号之后哪架航天飞机，何时发射？

ex.s: But there was never any doubt that manned flights would continue, and on 29 September 1988, the space shuttle programme resumed with the successful launch of Discovery.
ex.t: 但载人飞行会继续这一点从未有过任何疑问，1988年9月29日，航天飞机计划随着发现号的成功发射而恢复。

ex.s: We didn’t have much patience waiting for the launch.
ex.t: 我们没有太多耐心等待发射。

ex.s: If you want to have a business of your own, your local library can become a launch space for it.
ex.t: 如果你想有自己的业务,你的本地图书馆可以成为它的发射空间.

defs.def: a large boat with a motor 大型汽艇；机动大舢板；交通艇
